name: GatherParty
description: Call the followers near the player to them.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for members of your Nether's Follower Framework party. Acts on the followers near you: those within about 30 m follow again, and a following member 2000 to 8192 units away and out of sight is moved right behind you. Followers left waiting farther away stay where they are.
prompt: If the player calls the whole party or everyone to gather or come to them, begin your response with '{key}:'
